Add Organization markup with url, logo and sameAs so AI answers name you right.

Tie each field to a <label for>, or give it an aria-label. A screen reader can only announce a name that exists.

Neiva's sitemap lists a host that won't load.

ITU: framing locked, but no HSTS.

Send Strict-Transport-Security with a max-age of at least a year, and point / straight at the final page.
